explication: Luvus is a persistent, cross-platform terminal mission-control app for AI coding agents. A user launches or reattaches to a named session, works in panes and tabs, and starts agents; the server manages terminal processes and agent status while the TUI renders controls and workspace state. The product also includes Git/file tools, orchestration and scheduling, remote machines, extensible modules, and an optional browser client. The graph follows documented capabilities and SOURCE INDEX references; unsampled internals are represented at their known source paths without asserting unverified call chains.
